name: Twinboiler Fusiliers
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D fantasy strategy game animated sprite source. True transparent RGBA background. Exactly four full-body poses of ONE original upgraded Brasshollow creature in a perfectly regular 2x2 grid with equal square cells, wide clear transparent gutters. Painterly richly textured fantasy unit art, weathered brass and soot-black iron, warm directional light. Right-facing three-quarter camera; same identity, design, equipment, proportions and scale in all four cells. Full body and all weapons visible with generous 8% margin EACH cell. Same planted feet/paws positions in every cell. Four genuinely articulated idle keyframes reading row-major, visibly different joint and equipment angles; no static duplicate cutouts. No text, caption, watermark, gridlines, checkerboard, environment, scenery, floor or platform.  CRITICAL LAYOUT: make sheet square 1536x1536. Each of 4 cells is768x768. Draw characters substantially SMALLER within cells: subject occupies at most 70% of cell height and width, leave a full100px EMPTY margin on ALL sides of each subject. Nothing may touch outer image boundary or central seams.Creature Twinboiler Fusiliers. Heavy masked fusilier with TWO large rounded pressure boilers behind shoulders, wide multi-nozzle brass rivet gun held with both gauntlets, asymmetric valves and braided feed pipes, armored booted legs and short leather waist apron. Idle: 1 gun at waist low; 2 elbows bend lifting triple muzzle slightly; 3 shoulders compress and right wrist reaches side pressure valve while left elbow supports gun; 4 valve hand returns and gun lowers halfway. Both large boilers identical between frames. Visible hands and elbow joint changes.
reference_use: Original generation based on approved unit upgrade design brief.
